summary: Interactive table and NL shell configurator for koru config

delivery.outcome: Expose koru config command that displays rich ASCII/Unicode configuration tables and prompts interactively via shell CLI and natural language commands (tripartite NL-DSL-LLM pattern).
nonGoals: No breaking changes to koru configure non-interactive or schema v1/v2 format
No network dependency required for offline table display or local regex/keyword NL parser

architecture.decision: Alias and enhance koru config / koru configure with table rendering and interactive NL command parsing loop in koru.configurator.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; restore previous configurator modules.

validation.evidence: Config table renderer produces clear formatted ASCII/rich table of all settings.
koru config subcommand works as expected both interactively and with --table flag.
All configurator tests pass cleanly and ruff reports 0 lint errors.
Governance check passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings (GOV-PASS).
